hook.text: In 2016, a hashtag trended worldwide in two hours. Thousands of accounts pushed it. None were real people.

buildup.text: Bot networks are coordinated fake accounts that amplify messages. They mimic human behavior: posting, liking, replying.

discovery.text: Researchers estimate 15% of Twitter accounts were bots. They inflated trends, boosted politicians, and sold products.

twist.text: Modern bots use AI to write unique posts. They pass detection filters. The line between bot and human blurs.

climax.text: Platforms remove millions of bots monthly. New ones appear faster. It's a permanent arms race with no finish line.

punchline.text: Half the outrage online may come from no one.

quiz.question: What do bot networks do on social media?
options: Amplify messages by mimicking human behavior
